applied.fact: access.fees claims no fee; access.passRequired states an explicit dollar fee

access.fees: None — no climbing fee (National Forest, not Mount Rainier NP)
access.notes: Many of these peaks (Mount Persis, Gunn Peak, Baring Mountain area) sit outside designated wilderness — administratively unrestricted despite serious technical terrain.
access.closures: Access spur roads (FR6510/FR6514/FR6517) are prone to seasonal washouts, downed trees, and closures; check current Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF road-status alerts for the Skykomish District before driving.
access.landManager: Mount Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest, Skykomish Ranger District (Skykomish Ranger Station, 74920 NE Stevens Pass Hwy, Skykomish WA 98288, (360) 677-2414)
access.land_manager: Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest (Skykomish Ranger District)
access.parking_pass: Northwest Forest Pass or America the Beautiful pass required at developed trailheads.
access.passRequired: Northwest Forest Pass required at the FR6517 trailhead parking — $5/day or $30/year (also honored: America the Beautiful federal interagency pass)

overnight_permit.what: No overnight permit required; camping is banned within a quarter mile of Lake Serene
overnight_permit.where: A Northwest Forest Pass is needed to park at the Barclay Lake and Lake Serene trailheads. Drive-in campgrounds are reserved on Recreation.gov.
